## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed value is from the cited source, with a page and a short locator in its `src`; facts only (no copied tables, text or graph readings).
- [ ] I compared the values against the datasheet at the cited pages (the fact table comment below links them).
- [ ] Documents I checked completely have a `review` block with my GitHub login in `by` and this pull request's number in `pr`.
- [ ] Documents I changed but did not review completely have no `review` block (removed if they had one).
- [ ] No PDFs or other copies of manufacturer documents are added.
- [ ] `./scripts/validate.sh` passes, files formatted (`./scripts/fmt.sh`), or I rely on the CI check.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
